facts.fact: Skyline International for Human Rights says Sudan's Cybercrime Law has been amended repeatedly, in 2018, 2020 and 2022, and that the Cabinet approved a further draft amendment on 13 October 2025.

Skyline International for Human Rights says the Sudanese Union of Journalists and local rights defenders warned that the Cabinet's October 2025 Cybercrime Law amendments will be used to criminalise free speech.

SDN.note: No local research institution is named.

facts.fact: Skyline International for Human Rights says the Cybercrime Law amendments approved by the Cabinet on 13 October 2025 were passed without transparency or public consultation.
